humanTitle: People are stuck signing in to an account that no longer exists
whoItAffects: Android users in the United States, across two app versions.

build.proposition: A way to remove an account from the device without removing the app.
specifics: List the signed-in identities and let one of them be deleted
Fall back to the identity picker when an organisation is gone
Return a named error at the login screen instead of a page
build.limitation: Identity state is owned by the directory, and a device cannot always tell a revoked account from an unreachable one.

start.proposition: An identity switcher that treats work accounts as things people leave.
specifics: Clears an account from the device the moment access ends
Aimed at contractors and anyone belonging to more than one organisation
start.limitation: Every directory handles departure differently, and any app doing this is a guest inside all of them.

study.proposition: What is left on a device when someone leaves an organisation?
specifics: Follow the remains: tokens, caches, and the sign-in screen itself
Compare what the person sees with what the directory believes
study.limitation: Departures are private, and the people best placed to describe one have just lost the access needed to ask.

write.proposition: You left the company. The app did not.
specifics: Follow one leaver through a login screen that will not let go
Quote the reviewer prompted daily for an account that is gone
write.limitation: It reads as an edge case, and nothing in these reviews shows how often it happens.
